race.comment: ZEPHYR SONG (11) should be hitting his straps fourth-up after narrowly missing here last time. Gets in well with the in-form claimer taking over with 3kgs coming off. Will land handy from the low draw and be in this for a long way. IMMINENT APPEAL (1) drops back from Saturday company after a solid Eagle Farm second. Gets in light with Pozman's 3kg claim and should appreciate stretching out the extra 150m. CRAZY EIGHTS (5) was held up at the top of the straight last start at Ipswich but chased gamely into fourth once getting through. The form around him is sticking up and he gets a key switch in Thompson, who will need to be on top of his game from out there. DUN DARTE CHEAP (7) has mixed his form since resuming but was better last time at the Sunny Coast when ridden positively. Houston goes on and claims 2kg, suspect they will push forward again under the light weight.
